cases.message: `x := if <cond> { <call> }` is retired in edition 2026: write `if <cond> { x := <call> }`
`steps.<id>...` is retired in edition 2026: a statement's name is its value, so write `<id>`
`for x := range <source>` is retired in edition 2026: write `for x in <source>`
`forEach` is retired in edition 2026: write `for <x> in <source> if <cond> { }`
`publishEvent(...)` is retired in edition 2026: write `publish "<topic>" { ... }` in an automation
`partition=` on @trigger is retired in edition 2026: delete it
`body { }` is retired in edition 2026: an automation's statements follow its args block directly
`step run { ... }` is retired in edition 2026: write the step's call as a statement, `run := <call>`
the terse `automation terseHeader @trigger(...) => logic L` form is retired in edition 2026: write @trigger(...) above `automation terseHeader { logic L(event: event) }`
